basic_info.description: Beautifully positioned on a tree-lined block of distinctive homes, this circa 1912 triplex offers exciting prospects for owner-occupants & investors alike. Smart updates combined w/ preserved vintage characteristics keep this grand property well grounded in both past & present. All units showcase hints of a bygone era: lincrusta, gumwood paneling, box beam ceilings, original light fixtures, ornate fireplaces, hardwood floors & oversize windows.   The top floor flat (#50) features a 2016 kitchen remodel accented by a vintage Spark stove, center island w/ auxiliary sink & a separate pantry. The middle flat (#50A) underwent a complete kitchen remodel in 2025 plus fresh paint, refinished floors & newly installed wall heaters throughout. The lower flat (#50B) is currently occupied by responsible tenants. Split bathrooms in all units have had moderate updates over the years yet remain largely original & in need of a refresh.  The garage level accommodates up to three vehicles in addition to generous amounts of storage. Developers may see potential for adding an ADU. The rear deck & stair assembly has been newly rebuilt & affords all units direct access to the quiet backyard w/ brick patio. Duboce Park, MUNI lines, bike routes & cafes are right outside your door. Nothing else compares
